comment: Session-title generation asks for a 64-token completion with thinking off.

When a background command finishes, the plugin injects its completion notice into the session. This rule reacts to that notice: it captures the job id out of the notice text (`job (task-N)`) and calls the real `job_output` tool with it, so the job's stdout/stderr comes back through the harness and is recorded in this server's request log — the only way to read a job's own output without a human in the loop.
Default rule: mirror the last user message.
